title: Feel the G
captions:
Feel the G. See the G. 🌀

Lateral G shows how hard you're loading the kart through every corner. Longitudinal G shows every braking zone and every exit.

Overlay two laps in the Kart Connect Data Logger and see exactly who's committing more in the fast stuff, and who's braking later. 🔥

🔗 kart-connect.com

Think you're braking late? The G trace knows. 👀

Longitudinal G shows every braking point, lateral G shows how much grip you're actually using. Put your lap next to a quicker one and the difference jumps out. 🏁

title: Brake later. Prove it.
captions:
Brake later. Prove it. 🛑

Every dip in the longitudinal G trace is a braking zone. Lay two laps over each other in the Kart Connect Data Logger and you'll see exactly who's braking later, and who's braking harder.

No more "I was definitely later than him". The data settles it. 😏

title: Watch the gap grow
captions:
Watch the gap grow. ⏱️

The Δ Time trace in the Kart Connect Data Logger shows the gap between two laps building up metre by metre. Flat line? You're matching them. Climbing? That's where the time's going.

Find the corner. Fix the corner. 🏁

title: Overlay or separate
captions:
Pick your channels. Your order. ⚙️

RPM first? Speed first? G-force at the top? Your call.

In the Kart Connect Data Logger you turn channels on and off, drag them into the order you want, and flip between overlay and separate views in one tap. 🏁
